title: The Price of Thinking: Reasoning Effort as a Model-Specific API Contract
abstract: arXiv:2608.16956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: API buyers purchase a dated contract, not a model name alone: the contract includes the requested and served model, reasoning-effort term or its omission, output rail, service product, prompt, and price schedule. We study the reasoning-effort term through a registered paired contrast of Sonnet 5 with explicit high effort against the same model with effort omitted, using 30 AIME 2026 items and five calls per item. Every paid attempt was assigned one frozen terminal category, and inference resampled items while retaining their repeated calls. Mean delivered cost was \$0.01031 per call higher under the explicit-high contract than under the omitted contract [+\$0.00204, +\$0.01974]. The corresponding accuracy contrast was +0.0133 [-0.0267, +0.0467]; we did not detect an accuracy difference, and the interval permits a gain of up to 4.67 percentage points that this design cannot rule out. translated_title: 思考的代价：推理努力作为模型特定的API契约
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16956v1 公告类型：新公告  摘要：API买家购买的是带日期的契约，而非仅模型名称：契约包括请求和服务的模型、推理努力条款或其省略、输出轨道、服务产品、提示词和价格计划。我们通过注册的配对对比研究了推理努力条款，对比了Sonnet 5显式高努力与省略努力的同一模型，使用30个AIME 2026题目，每题调用五次。每次付费尝试被分配一个固定的终止类别，推理重采样题目同时保留其重复调用。在显式高契约下，每次调用的平均交付成本比省略契约高\$0.01031 [+\$0.00204, +\$0.01974]。相应的准确度对比为+0.0133 [-0.0267, +0.0467]；我们未检测到准确度差异，且区间允许高达4.67个百分点的增益，此设计无法排除。在高努力下，每个正确答案的成本为\$0.08665。
tldr: 本研究通过配对实验发现，显式指定高推理努力会增加API调用成本，但未检测到显著的准确度提升，表明推理努力条款在模型中可能不带来实际收益。
en_tdlr: This study, through paired experiments, finds that explicitly specifying high reasoning effort increases API call costs without detecting significant accuracy improvements, suggesting the reasoning-effort term may not yield practical benefits in the model.
